label: common_1200_question_01a

text: What is an AI, really?

label: common_1200_answer_01_01a
text: An AI is an artificial intelligence created by a\nhuman being.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_01_01b
text: An AI is an artificial intelligence created by a\nhuman being.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_01_02a
text: A computer draws on the original professor’s\nknowledge and memories to calculate all of my\r\nthoughts and actions.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_01_02b
text: A computer draws on the original professor’s\nknowledge and memories to calculate all of my\r\nthoughts and actions.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_01_03a
text: The results of those calculations are expressed\nby this mechanical body, built to resemble the\r\nprofessor in every way.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_01_03b
text: The results of those calculations are expressed\nby this mechanical body, built to resemble the\r\nprofessor in every way.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_01_04a
text: Humanity does not, in fact, possess the\nknowledge to develop such a sophisticated AI\r\nat present.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_01_04b
text: Humanity does not, in fact, possess the\nknowledge to develop such a sophisticated AI\r\nat present.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_01_05a
text: But the crystals that make up the Zero Lab have\nmade such a thing possible here.\c\nThey are also why I cannot leave this place.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_01_05b
text: But the crystals that make up the Zero Lab have\nmade such a thing possible here.\c\nThey are also why I cannot leave this place.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_02_01a
text: As I explained to you before, the original\nprofessor no longer exists.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_02_01b
text: As I explained to you before, the original\nprofessor no longer exists.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_02_02a
text: During the destruction of the research station,\nher physical body received grievous injuries\r\nthat left it unable to sustain life.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_02_02b
text: During the destruction of the research station,\nhis physical body received grievous injuries\r\nthat left it unable to sustain life.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_02_03a
text: I am afraid that this fact may be difficult for her\nson, Arven, to accept.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_02_03b
text: I am afraid that this fact may be difficult for his\nson, Arven, to accept.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_02_04a
text: I now manage the Zero Lab in the original\nprofessor’s place.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_02_04b
text: I now manage the Zero Lab in the original\nprofessor’s place.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_03_01a
text: The time machine is a device that the original\nprofessor and I worked on together.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_03_01b
text: The time machine is a device that the original\nprofessor and I worked on together.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_03_02a
text: It sends Poké Balls to a different point on the\ntimeline to catch Pokémon there, and it can\r\nthen draw them back here to the present.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_03_02b
text: It sends Poké Balls to a different point on the\ntimeline to catch Pokémon there, and it can\r\nthen draw them back here to the present.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_03_03a
text: When she was alive, Professor Sada had a great\nfascination with Pokémon from another age—\r\nwhat you might call [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]ancient Pokémon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_03_03b
text: When he was alive, Professor Turo had a great\nfascination with Pokémon from another age—\r\nwhat you might call [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]future Pokémon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_answer_03_04a
text: Even as we speak, the time machine continues to\nautomatically draw ancient Pokémon to this time.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_answer_03_04b
text: Even as we speak, the time machine continues to\nautomatically draw future Pokémon to this time.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_hakase_01a
text: The original professor had a dream...of a world\nin which ancient Pokémon might live alongside\r\npresent-day Pokémon in harmony.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_hakase_01b
text: The original professor had a dream...of a world\nin which future Pokémon might live alongside\r\npresent-day Pokémon in harmony.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_hakase_02a
text: But these Pokémon’s powers seem to stem\nfrom a primal energy of the ancient past...\r\nand this energy has proved too terrible.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_hakase_02b
text: But these Pokémon have gained a strange power\ndue to their adaptations in the distant future...\r\nand this power has proved too terrible.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_hakase_03a
text: Their very existence brings destruction to the\necological balance of this modern age.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_hakase_03b
text: Their very existence brings destruction to the\necological balance of this current age.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_hakase_04a
text: The original professor would say that such\ndestruction is a natural part of life.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_hakase_04b
text: The original professor would say that such\ndestruction is a natural part of life.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_hakase_05a
text: At present, the barrier around Area Zero is still\nworking to keep the ancient Pokémon from\r\nescaping into the rest of Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_hakase_05b
text: At present, the barrier around Area Zero is still\nworking to keep the future Pokémon from\r\nescaping into the rest of Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_hakase_06a
text: But we’ve begun to see Pokémon appear that\ncan break the barrier—such as Great Tusk.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_hakase_06b
text: But we’ve begun to see Pokémon appear that\ncan break the barrier—such as Iron Treads.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_hakase_07a
text: Eventually they will break free of this walled\ngarden known as Area Zero and run rampant\r\nacross the Paldea region.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_hakase_07b
text: Eventually they will break free of this walled\ngarden known as Area Zero and run rampant\r\nacross the Paldea region.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_hakase_08a
text: And when they do, the rich and varied ecosystem\nof Paldea will be trampled beneath their coming.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_hakase_08b
text: And when they do, the rich and varied ecosystem\nof Paldea will be trampled beneath their coming.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_hakase_09a
text: I may have been created as a copy of the\nprofessor, and yet...[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_hakase_09b
text: I may have been created as a copy of the\nprofessor, and yet...[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_hakase_10a
text: I cannot seem to find the logic in allowing such\na tragedy to occur.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1200_hakase_10b
text: I cannot seem to find the logic in allowing such\na tragedy to occur.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1200_hakase_11a
